$comment: C-1 (container-images spec §5): the `registry` connection's config: {host}, a bare registry hostname with an optional port. Credentials are {username, password} (a PAT, an ECR token, a robot account) sealed in the existing envelope. Validated by registryConfigSchema (app/src/lib/connections/schemas.ts, strict: lowercase only) and parse_registry_config (pipeline/connections/registry.py, which strips and case-folds). Both host checks reuse the image reference grammar's HOST fragment (image-reference.json) rather than a separate regex, so every host a credential can be configured for is a host an image reference can name. Docker Hub's short host `docker.io` is probed at registry-1.docker.io.

cases.name: Docker Hub by its short name
a label with a leading hyphen
a port with too many digits
a single-label host (the reference grammar admits no bare label but localhost)
uppercase (the writer stores lowercase; the reader folds)
